critical_code_review_comments: seed_data.py only sets password_hash if missing — a rotated ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env will NOT propagate to existing owner user; consider re-hashing when ADMIN_PASSWORD env changes (edge case; not required by spec)

Login lockout uses locked_until updated on EVERY failed attempt, effectively rolling window. Acceptable but note count never auto-resets except on success — recommend TTL index on login_attempts.locked_until so stale docs disappear
Cookie is set with SameSite=None; Secure — correct for cross-site preview; ensure production domain is served over HTTPS (it is)

response.set_cookie in login endpoint OK, but /auth/logout uses response.delete_cookie without path='/' matching secure=True/samesite=None attributes — browsers may keep cookie. Consider passing same attrs. Not blocking; Bearer flow works.
get_current_user reads token from cookie OR Bearer — good. Password comparisons use bcrypt.checkpw wrapped in try/except returning False — safe.
reset_admin_password accepts raw dict (no Pydantic model) — works but inconsistent with rest of API
seed_data_creation: None persisted — all disposable test users/attempts cleaned up
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth is fully migrated to username/password. Bcrypt hashes are $2b$12$. Legacy test_session_* Bearer tokens still work for read-only regression. All CRUD/RBAC endpoints from iteration_1 remain functional (spot-checked via /santri, /admins, /auth/me).
